preservedResponsibilities: Maps represented emphasis, code, hyperlink and strikeout span callbacks plus backslash/whitespace hard breaks and soft breaks into Writer text runs; preserves the pinned empty entity/null-character text callbacks by omitting recognized HTML references and null characters while retaining unrecognized text and literal code spans. Relative hyperlink targets resolve against a supplied document base URL while fragment-only targets remain unchanged.
Uses the pinned md4c syntactic entity recognizer instead of a host HTML entity dictionary, so every native named/numeric entity callback is omitted, including unknown names.
omittedResponsibilities: Complete upstream Markdown grammar, HTML, images, frames, complex styles, fields and desktop filter options remain unverified.

local.marker: maps hard and soft line breaks
omits syntactic entity and null-character callbacks
